question: None shared. The intended P-112 paper (Oltu et al. 2021, read from the repository PDF mapped to P-111) stages AD vs MCI vs healthy controls from resting EEG. P-62's only MCI result identifies the underlying pathology (AD vs DLB vs iNPH) within MCI patients, and its healthy-volunteer contrasts are against dementia, not MCI. The pack PDF for P-112 is a different paper (Ghoraani et al., dual-task gait), which would also fail the channel test.
metric: Mismatch: plain epoch-level accuracy (and AUC) for three-class staging vs subject-level balanced accuracy for etiological subtyping.

figures.P-112: Oltu et al.: three-class AD/MCI/HC accuracy 96.5% with ROC AUC 0.99, from epoch-level 5-fold CV over the epochs of 35 subjects (16 MCI, 8 AD, 11 HC); a 50/50 subject split gives test accuracy 93.88%. The pack PDF (Ghoraani gait study) gives three-class accuracy 78% (32 healthy, 26 MCI, 20 AD).
figures.P-62: MCI group at Hospital O (n = 83), pathology AD vs DLB vs iNPH: bACC 0.715, ROC AUC 0.847. Healthy volunteers vs dementia: bACC 0.927 internal, 0.805 and 0.920 external. No MCI vs healthy or AD/MCI/HC staging result. No interval arithmetic was done because no shared quantity exists.

matched_figure_check: No matched figure is possible: P-62 prints no result for the staging contrast, and P-112/Oltu prints none for pathology subtyping within MCI.
performance_validity: Fails for the intended P-112 paper. It reports AUC 0.99 on internal validation only, with 35 subjects, epoch-level CV (epochs of one subject can fall on both sides) and no external cohort. P-62 (external hospitals; bACC at most 0.927) passes.
reason: The two papers answer different clinical questions: three-stage AD/MCI/HC classification against identification of the pathology underlying MCI. The ledger's 'more moderate MCI-related balanced performance' misreads P-62's subtype bACC as MCI detection. The metrics differ as well (epoch-level accuracy vs subject-level bACC), and the intended P-112 result meets the Section 3.5 exclusion (AUC 0.99, N = 35, internal epoch-level CV).
